instruction: Open the plugin list document on the desktop and install at least one of the recommended Chrome extensions from the Web Store.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing at least one extension from the list. Custom metric returns 1.0 if any of the 5 expected extensions is installed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file by reading extensions.settings[id].manifest.name (chrome.py:1460-1472)
Metric correctly implements 'at least one' logic using set intersection to check if any expected extension is installed (chrome.py:25-38)
Expected parameter handling is correct - directly accesses expected.get('expected', []) from rules dict (chrome.py:21), which is the correct pattern for type='rule'
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the instruction's verifiable outcome: at least one of the 5 recommended extensions is installed
State is accessible via persistent Chrome Preferences JSON file at ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences, no UI dependency
Postconfig opens chrome://extensions for visual confirmation only, not required for verification logic
Edge cases handled correctly - getter returns empty list if file read fails (chrome.py:1471), metric returns 0.0 if no extensions match (chrome.py:38)

The evaluator verifies the end result (extension installed) rather than intermediate steps (opening document), which is semantically correct since the instruction's success criterion is installing at least one extension
